column_description: ID of the cell that triggered the alert. may be NULL.
Type of alert (e.g., high value, low value). always exactly one of 'high value', 'low value'. may be NULL.
Date when the alert was generated. may be NULL.
Message providing details about the alert. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the alert was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the alert was last updated. may be NULL.
